title: Hoe vindt u het om vrouw te zijn 1974
authors: Nederlandse onderneming voor uitgevers marktonderzoek, NOVUM * Haarlem (primary investigator)
contributors: NSS nv v/h Nederlandse stichting voor de statistiek * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: Discrimination of women / inborn and acquired qualities of men and women / opinion on position and role of women / attitude towards working mothers and equal division of work and domestic work between husband and wife / feelings during pregnancy and childbirth / opinion about marriage or relation with husband / family planning / opinion on domestic work / division of tasks in household / education of children / adoption of children / membership of organizations for women / attitude towards emancipation groups for women / feelings of discrimination / influence of emancipation groups / job / sexual life. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ education/ social class/ politics/ religion/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure
